scene: An open wooden doorway leads into a bright hall.
Room signs are ahead, beside a white kiosk.
instruction: Turn right to check the signs.

scene: Restroom signs lead into the corridor on your right.
instruction: Turn right toward the restroom signs.

scene: The accessible restroom is beside the yellow door.
instruction: Turn around toward the main hall.

scene: The main hall stretches ahead, with seats along the side.
A wide open space leads toward the bright windows.
instruction: Keep moving forward at a steady pace.

scene: An overhead sign marks the way across the lobby.
The hall opens up, with large columns on the right.
instruction: Keep slightly left of the columns.

scene: A cleaner is working ahead near the flags.
instruction: Slow down as you pass the cleaner.

scene: A corridor entrance is beside the flag display.
A row of lifts is on your left.
White lockers line a narrower passage ahead.
instruction: Follow the passage between the lockers.

scene: The locker passage turns beside a wooden door.
instruction: Follow the bend in the locker passage.

scene: A ground-floor directory stands beside the lockers.
This is BSG35, the stationery room.
The double doors are marked BSG33.
instruction: Stop here. You have reached the doorway.
